limitations: Distribution in n is over one complete period for each fixed k. No short-interval sampling guarantee, no eventual sign claim for the parity bias, and some risk of prior implicit asymptotic coverage in inaccessible general frequency-law literature.
scientific_integrity: Self-contained exact finite-period proof and conditional use of standard unconditional analytic theorems; computation is confirmatory, not a replacement for proof. No external independent audit.
title: Gaussian distinct-prime-factor law and sharp parity bias for consecutive LCM quotients
